files.reason: User-compiled single-sheet workbook: site withdrawal by source (fresh surface, ground, sea, municipal) 2019-2021 transcribed from FQM 2021 ESG Data Summary p.56, plus a hand-compiled block of rounded site withdrawal, intensity (m3/t ore) and reuse rates. Many cells are derived formulas (estimates) and were NOT extracted.

observations: Source is not an original FQM data file: single sheet "Tabelle1" assembled by a user (German Excel), with stray unrelated cells (A1 "Wunugetushan", A2 "Bangpu" marked "PoDe"; DC365 a URL to an Antamina 2017 report). Only hard-coded input cells were extracted.

All 98 formula cells were skipped: 2019 site withdrawal in C7:C14 (estimated as "share in total" x total, i.e. not reported), "Total water use" L:N (= withdrawal/(1-reuse), derived), "Ore production [kt]" P:Q (= withdrawal/intensity, back-calculated - so no ore-processed figures are extractable), D15/E15 SUMs, and site totals "Water withdrawal: total (excl. Sea water)" C27:E34 (SUMIF of the source rows). No FQM-stated site withdrawal totals exist in the ESG-summary block.

Two inconsistent 2019 corporate totals in the same sheet: C15 = 252,853 ML (hand-compiled block) vs C24 = 247,853 ML (ESG Data Summary). The 5,000 ML gap looks like a typo; 247,853 reconciles with surface 200,706 + ground 45,576 + municipal 1,160 + sea 412 (= 247,854).

Corporate totals 2020 = 238,070 ML and 2021 = 263,162 ML; they reconcile with fresh surface + ground + municipal + sea (Çayeli & Ravensthorpe only). Cobre Panamá power-station cooling seawater (446,748 / 468,517 / 438,064 ML in 2019/20/21) is excluded from totals and recorded under other:withdrawal_sea_power_cooling.

Hand-compiled block rows 7-14 are inconsistent in basis: Cobre Panamá 2020 = 581,900 ML includes cooling seawater (113,321 operational + 468,517 cooling), while 2021 = 138,100 ML excludes it. Ravensthorpe 6,600/6,300 ML include ~5,500 ML seawater; its ESG-summary non-sea withdrawal is only ~1,000/756 ML.

Cobre Panamá dominates: ~48-52% of operational withdrawal (121,848 / 113,321 / 138,073 ML excl. sea, from SUMIF helper), almost all fresh surface water. Kansanshi is groundwater-dominated (31,525 / 26,407 / 33,921 ML ground). Ravensthorpe groundwater jumps from 55 ML (2019) to 511 ML (2020); its seawater from 125 to 5,516 ML.

Reuse rates (column "Reuse", fractions): Cobre Panamá rose 59% -> 70% -> 78%; Kansanshi fell 78% -> 76% -> 66%; Ravensthorpe 2019 blank. Unclear whether these are reuse/total water use or reuse/withdrawal.
No discharge, consumption, water-stress, incidents or fines data in this file. Guelb Moghrein surface water appears only in 2021 (64 ML).
Site names normalised: "Cayeli"/"Çayeli" -> Çayeli, "Cobre las Cruces" -> Cobre Las Cruces, "Cobre Panama" -> Cobre Panamá.
